async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Stores' link in the menubar to navigate to the Stores section
    await page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name='Stores').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # After clicking Stores, look for 'Orders' or related links in the page
    # Use a flexible search for 'Orders' in links or buttons
    try:
        await page.get_by_role('link', name='Orders', exact=False).click(timeout=5000)
    except:
        # If 'Orders' link not found, try 'Order Status' as seen in the tree
        await page.get_by_role('link', name='Order Status').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now, I should be on a page related to orders. Search for order #301.
    # Look for a search input and fill with '301'
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search').fill('301')
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Click on order #301 to open details
    await page.get_by_role('cell', name='301').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Edit the shipping address
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Edit Shipping Address').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Street Address').fill('321 Birch Boulevard, Suite 200')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='City').fill('Dallas')
    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='State/Province').select_option('Texas')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='ZIP/Postal Code').fill('75201')
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Save Address').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
